title: lotus tenellus
intro: Lotus tenellus, commonly known as Dwarf Lotus, is a type of flowering plant in the Nelumbo genus. This plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Lotus tenellus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and digestive issues. Therapeutically, the plant is known to exhibit analgesic, anti-edematous, and anti-hypertensive actions, suggesting its potential in treating pain, inflammation, and high blood pressure.
